findings.desc: quality-tautology: review-run-metadataroot-wrapper-root-smoke.ts:394-400 Proof C is tautological — both `fallback` and `explicit` call checkEvidenceFreshnessForGit with identical arguments (root, root), so deepEqual always passes and the assertion does not actually exercise the legacy-fallback path through the consumer code (run.workspaceBinding?.metadataRoot ?? projectRoot). The test is supposed to verify that a ReviewRun with no workspaceBinding falls back to projectRoot, but it never constructs such a run or calls assertCurrentReviewRunForEvidence; it only compares a function with itself.
